dataset_title: PulmoSIMU A1 preliminary bilateral lung airspace research baseline
origin_dataset: National Lung Screening Trial (NLST) — The Cancer Imaging Archive
origin_license: CC BY 4.0 (TCIA public NLST radiology CT images)
processing_notice: Derived NIfTI and GLB are transformations and preliminary segmentations; study-specific correspondence to an individual TCIA series has not been independently established.
processing_method: HU(-1010,-400), body enclosure, 2D largest hemithorax components, morphological smoothing; mesh decimation
limitations: No clinician-reviewed fissures or five-lobe segmentation
No segmented bronchial lumen or pulmonary vascular tree
Thresholding may omit consolidated/high-attenuation lung or include non-lung air
Provisional right-surface cross-midline leakage flagged for review
Watertightness and mesh decimation metrics are not evidence of anatomical fidelity
The old A2 candidate label swap is invalid because the NIfTI RAS X convention was inverted.
data_distribution_note: Public text metadata only. Candidate and original binary GLBs and CT are not GitHub Release assets as of this commit.

anatomical_laterality_check.status: HISTORICAL WRONG SIGN - NOT A VALID LATERALITY CORRECTION

review_notes: Archived candidate was generated with RAS +X incorrectly interpreted as patient LEFT; real RAS +X is patient RIGHT.
Candidate labels were swapped unjustifiably and this candidate is INVALID for research side labels.
Historical mesh overlaps by 16.33 mL; A2.1 conservative masks are a separate new candidate, not a relabel of this GLB.
No validated airway or five lobes; no CT-linked procedure.
